name: environment
command: import os,sys,json,platform,importlib.metadata as m,tico,torch;print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"platform":platform.platform(),"cpu_count":os.cpu_count(),"cpu_affinity":list(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),"tico_file":tico.__file__,"cuda_available":torch.cuda.is_available(),"versions":{p:m.version(p) if m.packages_distributions() and p in [d.metadata["Name"] for d in m.distributions()] else None for p in ["torch","torchvision","transformers","datasets","lm_eval","lm-eval","circle-schema","flatbuffers","tico","lintrunner"]}},indent=2))

name: resource-snapshot
command: date -u; nproc; lscpu; free -b; df -B1 /workspace; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max; git status --porcelain; git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree}; python -c "import tico; print(tico.__file__)"
